analysis:
Integration pass over both primary units and the replayed source. The replayed source is documentation and changelog only: GLM OpenRouter reasoning and strict tools, JSON mode and forced tool choice with withholding and post-generation validation, single-pass weight verification, VFR video, typed native output-control refusals, page cache counted as available memory, and test and doc updates. No concrete security regression is established from the supplied evidence.

Observations and unverified contracts:
(1) The managed GLM load's per-file SHA-256 verification is now the published weight hash. A coordinator-mode start can reuse ~/.darkbloom/verified-weights.json (owner-only 0600), bound to dev, inode, size, mtime and ctime. The store implementation, the ProviderLoop publishing path and the TOCTOU handling in GLM5NextManagedLoad are not visible. A same-user operator who forges the record is already the accepted adversary under T-012 and T-027 (hash self-reported, weights replaceable). The new surface is only a cached-attestation skip of rehashing, and it needs source review.
(2) Structured output and forced tool_choice move from up-front refusal to withholding plus validation, with a 422 and no content on failure. The design is fail-closed, which is consistent with T-008 and A-001. The enforcement code, including the streaming-tool-call and bounded-buffer branches, is not in the supplied evidence.
(3) The typed 400 for unsupported output controls runs before reservation and is content-free, an availability improvement (T-010 class).
(4) Counting page cache as available memory is an availability and OOM trade-off with no confidentiality effect.
(5) T-041 SSD cache controls (HMAC names, 30-minute TTL, scope salt) are not touched in the visible units.
(6) The libs/mlx-swift-lm submodule bump and the VFR video processor (T-050 temp-file behavior) were not reviewable.

Deeper review is warranted for VerifiedWeightHashStore, ProviderLoop.verifiedGLM5NextWeightHash, the GLM5NextManagedLoad recheck, the engine withholding path and the submodule diff.
